data.one_liner: Set a device into BLE peripheral mode and advertise custom services.
data.what_it_does: Enables a mobile or desktop device to act as a Bluetooth Low Energy peripheral, broadcasting service UUIDs, manufacturer data, and service data. It also supports serving a local GATT server with characteristics for notifying and writing.
use_when: You need your Flutter app to act as a Bluetooth beacon or peripheral.
You want to host a GATT server to communicate with nearby central devices.
avoid_when: You only need to scan or connect to peripherals as a central device.
You need complex multi-service GATT hosting on platforms that restrict it.
strengths: Cross-platform support for Android, iOS, macOS, and Windows.
Includes GATT server capabilities with custom characteristics.
Handles background advertising on supported platforms.
weaknesses: Platform limitations restrict certain advertisement fields on iOS and macOS.
Requires native permission configurations for Bluetooth and location.
data.setup_notes: Requires permissions in AndroidManifest.xml, usage descriptions in Info.plist for iOS/macOS, and Bluetooth entitlements on macOS.
